descriptionMarkdown:
Automatically slows down on the way to the broken planet or if Ammunition is low.

- Just connect the Input to your Hub and read Inventory, Speed, Startpoint and Destination.
- Connect the Input to a piece of Pipe between Pump and Engines.
- Connect the Output to your Fuelpump and use the Configuration of the one in the Blueprint.
- Adjust the Values for your Ship.

The Standard Configuration travels on maxspeed to all Planets, incl. Aquilo, slows down to 200km/s from Aquilo to the Rim of the Solarsystem (and back) and to 100km/s on the way to the broken planet (also on the way back). If Ammo is below 1k (Rockets or Bullets) or 250 (Railgun) it slows down to 25km/s to restock.
At 25km/s and below it only pumps 1% of Oxidizer or Truster Fuel (you have to choose which one) into the pipe to shorten bursts after acceleration.

Update on 18. October 2026: Now with parameters for easy config.
title: Simple Speedcontrol for Promethiumship (with Parameters)
